shared_elements: upright rectangular slab treated as a single decorated field
repeated small motifs arranged in a row or ring
justification: Both are upright slabs with a bordered decorated field and some repeated small motifs, but that is essentially all they share: A shows an abstract multi-armed spiral disc ringed by discs with tiny quadruped animals in profile and wave/scroll bands, while B shows a densely packed elaborately costumed human figure with headdress and glyph-like blocks. The specific content — geometric solar rosette plus animals versus figural ceremonial scene with sign-blocks — has no distinctive correspondence.
